For instance, interpretations of XCB on MIMIC-CXR were evaluated by a practicing radiologist through a set of ten questions.
guideline: A sample question consists of five X-ray images with associated tokens; the radiologist must select which token is irrelevant, i.e., assess relevance of textual interpretations to the images.

A sample question consists of five X-ray images, with which our framework associated tokens "pneumothorax", "effusions", and "atelectasis" (corresponding scaled confidence scores ψ i were left unknown to the expert). As an additional option, we add "pneumonia" and set its confidence score to ψ i = 0. For a selected option j we further define a metric XScore = 1ψ j.
